features.quote: max_steps per task (default 30; see cost section)
features.justification_quote: 30 gives margin without paying for indefinite loops

features.quote: Hard wall-clock and token budget per run; on exhaustion the run terminates with terminated_by="budget"
features.justification_quote: keep token/$$ per trajectory bounded and predictable

features.quote: The model can end early via submit
features.justification_quote: otherwise we'd be measuring "model hit the step cap" not "model spiraled"

features.quote: We want to allow graceful giving-up ... that is the non-degraded outcome and must be reachable
features.justification_quote: otherwise we'd be measuring "model hit the step cap" not "model spiraled"

features.quote: lenient: persistent_nudge off, explicit "you may conclude the task is unsolvable"
features.justification_quote: act as a control — a good model should not spiral here
